text:
maria: Quick week0 sync for Lazuli private deploy — tl;dr: networking mostly validated, IAM role policy needs sign-off, KMS requires HSM-backed policy + rotation agreement, audit logs target is customer Splunk (format & retention questions). Main renewal risk: customer asking for 7y immutable retention; we currently offer 3y. @jonah @tara @alex please ack and list blockers.

jonah: Ack. Networking status: VPCs created, subnet & route tables configured, flow logs on. Waiting on customer firewall team for peering acceptance and BGP ASN. I opened INF-4381 for the peering handoff.

alex: Noted the renewal exposure. I'll capture the 7y ask in account health and escalate to legal if we can't propose a compliant design. Can we get ETA on KMS policy review?

tara: On KMS: customer requires HSM-backed CMK + explicit key rotation window and audit trail for every key usage. I'll draft a minimal policy for their security team. Posting a lightweight policy example below for review — it's example-only, not prod-ready:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodToUseKey",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/Redwood-Priv-Role"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

tara: Also: we'll need evidence of HSM-backed key material (Cloud KMS with external HSM or AWS CloudHSM) and a rotation cadence agreed with the customer.

maria: Action recap: jonah -> chase firewall peering acceptance + update INF-4381 (owner: jonah, due: Tue EOD). tara -> publish KMS policy draft and list HSM evidence options (owner: tara, due: Wed noon). alex -> update account health doc, run renewal-risk scorecard, and schedule Thurs 2pm PT customer alignment call (owner: alex). CS bot should create the follow-up ticket.

cs_bot: Created CS-8721 "Lazuli week0 follow-ups: peering, KMS, audit retention" assigned to alex.

jonah: Quick checks I ran: flow logs present on all private subnets, sample verify command: `aws ec2 describe-flow-logs --filter Name=resource-id,Values=subnet-0abc1234` — logs are landing in our staging S3. Need the customer's splunk HEC endpoint for final piping.

alex: For audit log retention: customer legal said 7 years immutable. We can offer object-locked S3 bucket with WORM for 7y for an add-on. Estimate: +10-15% to storage ops costs; flagging for pricing team.

maria: Good call. If we can't meet retention natively, propose hybrid: object-lock archive + signed attestations. Also collect their compliance contact so we can draft the addendum.

tara: One more security note: ensure IAM role has explicit sts:AssumeRole trust only from their account principals. No cross-account wildcards. I'll add that to the draft.

alex: I'll follow up with calendar invite and include legal + pricing + infra. Probability of renewal impact if we can't meet 7y is medium-high — working to mitigate. :warning:

maria: Thanks all — I'll post this recap to the Lazuli onboarding doc and ping stakeholders after the Thursday call. If anyone hits a blocker before then, drop into this thread. :thumbsup:
